stories.title: Align Provider Search Models to Existing Shared Contract (No New Schema)
stories.description: Refactor provider_search_models to strictly reuse and align with existing shared contract (FIND-P-M1), ensuring no new schema definitions are introduced and all inputs/outputs conform to canonical structures.

stories.title: Implement Vector Search with Taxonomy Fallback
stories.description: Implement provider search logic using MongoDB Atlas vector search with embedding queries, including scoring and ranking, and fallback to NUCC taxonomy-based filtering when vector results are insufficient or below threshold.

stories.title: Expose Provider Search via Find Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate provider_search_service into find_care_facade to orchestrate specialty identification, query expansion, location normalization, and search execution for tool routing and API consumption.

stories.title: Extend Existing Provider Search Tests (No Duplicate Coverage)
stories.description: Extend existing provider search test suite (FIND-P-M1) to cover vector ranking thresholds, taxonomy fallback triggers, and edge cases without duplicating baseline test cases already implemented.

stories.title: Validate Integration with Embeddings and Provider Data Pipelines
stories.description: Validate compatibility with embedding generation and provider data pipeline, ensuring correct vector usage, indexed collections, and alignment with loaded provider records for accurate and performant search results.
